rows.en: Miyasco: "The Spirit Mechs have been recovered.
The maintenance team has begun repairs."
Unfortunately, we could not find Ymir."
Derock: "...The bottom of that lake really does look suspicious."
Miyasco: "Yes. The Prana readings just keep rising...
They're almost impossible to measure now."
Sisk: "For now, we will remain on Type One alert
Yamato: "...To think they were inside that lake, meow...
And they'd formed a field underwater too."
Touya: "It's strange that people from 109 years ago
have better technology than we do now."
Yamato: "But Debish and the others really were people from 109 years ago,
Touya: "Yeah. That much seems certain, but..."
Yamato: "...Oh, th-that's right. I've got something to do...
Ai: "Um, this next battle might be
Touya: "I don't know what they think,
but I think it's about time we settled things."
Ai: "Yeah. So I thought I should finally ask properly.
You know, if you miss the right moment for this sort of thing,
it gets harder to ask... Or you never get to ask at all..."
Touya: "Huh? What are you trying to say?"
Ai: "Huh? I mean... Jeez, why don't you get it?!"
Touya: "What are you getting mad about all on your own?"
Ai: "!! Forget it! Sorry to bother you!"
Touya: "Tell me properly! I can't understand otherwise!"
Why did I ever fall for a guy like..."
Yamato: "...Honestly. You really should try to understand
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Is now a good time?"
Kasumi: "...Well, when I thought about the decisive battle finally being here,
And I wondered what you'd do at a time like this, Touya-chan..."
Touya: "What's wrong all of a sudden?"
Yamato: "...Oh, th-that's right. I've got something to do...
Kasumi: "After saying I'd fight alongside you...
It's pathetic to lose my nerve when it really matters, isn't it?"
That's not true. You're doing great, Kasumi.
You don't have to push yourself. That's why I'm here.
Touya: "Yeah, really. So don't worry so much.
It'll be all right. When things get rough, you've got me, don't you?"
Kasumi: "Yes... You're right. Somehow I feel so much better.
Hehehe... I'm happy, but I'm crying..."
Touya: "Hey, hey. Is that really something to cry about...?"
Touya: "Hey, hey. Is that really something to cry about...?"
Touya: "You really haven't changed since we were kids.
Kasumi: "Oh... Touya-chan, there's something on your shoulder..."
Touya: "Oh... I-It's fine! I can get it myself..."
Kasumi: "But you can't see it, can you?
I'll take it off for you, so hold still."
Kasumi: "...This happened before too, didn't it...?"
I have for a long, long time..."
Kasumi: "...It's strange. I could never say it before..."
Clovis: "Hey! It's about time we head..."
Clovis: "...I can have them delay things by about 30 minutes, if you like."
Clovis: "Heh... I understand. It's all right.
Yes, I know. You don't have to say it all."
Touya: "I told you, that's not it!"
Aurelie: "Huh?! Well, I was passing by,
so I thought... No, not exactly... Just, you know."
Yamato: "...Oh, th-that's right. I've got something to do...
Aurelie: "Huh? Well, the decisive battle's finally here, right?
Huh. Even you get like that.
Aurelie: "What's that supposed to mean? Even I
don't fight because I enjoy it.
...Don't tell me you really think that..."
Aurelie: "Well, you know. I'm sensitive too."
Aurelie: "Hey! You just made a face like you don't believe me!"
Touya: "No! Heaven forbid! I wasn't thinking that at all!
Aurelie: "...Fine. I'll make a special exception and forgive you.
In return, you're riding with me in this battle. All right?"
Aurelie: "Got it? No cheating on me!"
Aurelie: "Well, that's that. I'm counting on you.
I wouldn't be happy if I forced you to choose me.
Anyway, this might be the last time, so let's do our best! Okay?"
I've got something to do... Well then, excuse me..."
Celica: "Um, there's something I'd like to ask you."
Celica: "Touya, do you, um... like anyone?"
Touya: "!! Cough, cough! Wh-Where'd that come from?!"
Celica: "Why can't I ask? Anyway, do you?"
Touya: "Huh? You're the one who asked!"
Celica: "But if you said some other girl's name...
Touya: "...What did she come here for, anyway...?"
Touya: "When you ask someone a question, isn't it polite
Touya: "...Hey. Why are you backing away?"
...What did she come here for, anyway...?"
Kururu: "...Hey, is now a good time?"
Kururu: "...It's finally time to face them."
Kururu: "...U-Um, there's something I'd like to ask."
Kururu: "...Are you and Kasumi a couple, Touya?"
Well... I guess we are a couple.
It's not like that. We're just childhood friends.
That makes it sound like I just got rejected!
It's not... It's not like that!"
Kururu: "...Can I ask just one last thing?"
Kururu: "I'm not angry. I was a little sad, though."
Kururu: "Sorry for taking up your time. Bye."
Yamato: "...Are you all right with how that went?"
Kururu: "You know... I don't want to fight alone."
Kururu: "...I want to be with you, Touya."
Kururu: "Honestly... Are you going to make a girl say any more?"
Touya: "You mean riding in the Rayblade?"
Kururu: "Yay! You mean it? That's an absolute promise!"
Kururu: "You've made a good buy, mister!"
Touya: "I'm happy you feel that way, but..."
Kururu: "...No, you're right. You'd be nervous with someone like me.
Yamato: "Were you all right with how that went?"
Touya: "Yeah. I hope this is the last time..."
Yamato: "For now, we've just got to give it everything we have, meow."
Yamato: "Then you'd better do this properly for once, at the very end."
Yamato: "Honestly, Touya. Choose the girl you most want to be with right now
Yamato: "And the last one... Ah, here she comes."
Kururu: "You remember... your promise, don't you?"
Touya: "Yeah. Do you know how to pilot it?"
Kururu: "It's all right. I've studied up on it."
Kururu: "Hey! What's with that surprised look?"
Hey, if what you said then wasn't a lie,
would you say it properly for me one more time?"
Ai: "Touya. Once this battle is over,
if we make it back alive, I'll tell you properly.
Touya: "Y-Yeah... But it's not 'if we make it back alive.'
We are coming back alive. The two of us... No, all three."
Touya: "L-Looks like someone got the wrong idea."
Clovis: "You two over there! Could you board the Rayblade
soon? You're holding up everyone behind you."
once this battle is over, let's talk properly."
Let's make absolutely sure we come back."
Touya: "It's not fair to make a one-sided demand and walk off."
Aurelie: "...But if I hadn't done that,
I thought you wouldn't choose me..."
Touya: "Why would I lie about something like that?"
Let's make absolutely sure we come back alive."
Touya: "I still haven't answered your question from earlier."
Celica: "Hehehe... But it's all right now.
You chose me like this, after all...
So all that's left is to defeat ≪Ze=Ode≫... And then..."
Celica: "Oh... W-We'll continue this another time.
Miyasco: "Opening the hatch. Everyone, stay safe..."
Derock: "We'll leave the rest to you."
beat those bastards, and come right back.
